summary: This bill directs the Secretary of Transportation to issue regulations for the safe transport of lithium-ion batteries, including revising design tests, setting charge limits, and providing guidance for damaged batteries, and establishes a grant program for innovative thermal runaway suppression strategies and a grant program for fire departments to acquire related equipment.

scores.thoughts: This bill authorizes an appropriation of $10,000,000 for a grant program related to thermal runaway suppression strategies and establishes a new competitive grant program for fire departments to acquire equipment for suppressing thermal runaway events. These provisions directly lead to increased government spending.
